channel.title: GiveOwl – 12 Days of Christmas giveaways 2026
channel.description: "12 Days" giveaways are promotions where a sponsor gives away a different prize on each of twelve (or so) days, usually in late November or December. These are the ones from US sponsors we have checked against the official rules. Most treat each day as a separate drawing, so you may need to enter again every day.

item.title: The Filtery 12 Days of Non-Toxic Giveaways – The Filtery
item.description: Prize: 12 daily giveaways from non-toxic brands; grand prize Heavenly Heat ECO Sauna (ARV approx. $5,600). Deadline: November 24, 2026. Sign up for The Filtery newsletter and click the entry button in each day's giveaway email; each giveaway closes 11:59 pm PT the same day. One entry per person per day. Contiguous US, 18+ (grand prize excludes NY and FL). Entering adds you to The Filtery's and the featured brand's email lists

item.title: The Office Depot 12 Days of Giveaways – Office Depot, LLC
item.description: Prize: 12 office-product prize bundles (ARV $399.99–$1,269.97 each), one winner per bundle. Deadline: November 25, 2026. A new giveaway is announced each day Nov 9–20; enter each one once on officedepot.com/l/marketing/giveaways (email, phone, mailing address). All close Nov 25, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. 50 US + DC, age of majority

item.title: JCCC 12 Days of Christmas Giveaway: trading cards, Funko Pops and collectibles drawn nightly – Joshua's Cards Coins & Collectibles (JCCCShop.com)
item.description: Prize: 18 drawings (12 nightly drawings Nov 26 – Dec 7 plus a sneak-peek and bonus drawings), e.g. Shohei Ohtani and Topps NOW cards, a Dale Murphy signed ball, a Patrick Mahomes jersey, an American Mahjong set and a Pokémon 30th Anniversary Trainer Box and Booster Box ($249). Deadline: December 7, 2026. Submit the giveaway form (email only) on jcccshop.com/pages/jccc-holiday-giveaway; one entry covers every remaining drawing (entry must arrive before a drawing starts). Legal residents of the 50 US states and DC, 18+ (age of majority). Entries opened Nov 23 and must be received before 7 PM ET on Dec 7, 2026. One prize per household. No purchase necessary

item.title: 47abc Good Morning Delmarva 12 Days of Christmas 2026 Contest – WMDT 47abc (Marquee Broadcasting, Salisbury, MD)
item.description: Prize: Daily prizes from local sponsors (e.g. $150–$250 gift cards from Kozma Jewelers, Kuhn's Jewelers, Vernon Powell, SoDel Concepts; 4 Splash Mountain park passes; a Top Golf party for 8) and a grand prize of 2-carat lab-grown diamond stud earrings from Park Place Jewelers. Prizes must be collected at WMDT, 202 W Main St, Salisbury, MD within 10 days. Deadline: December 15, 2026. Fill in the «12 Days of Christmas» form on wmdt.com (name, address, email) – one entry per person per day; or email name, address and phone to wmdt@wmdt.com with «12 Days Contest» in the subject line. Free, 18+. Entries Nov 18 – Dec 15, 2026 4 p.m.; daily winners announced on Good Morning Delmarva from Dec 1, grand prize Dec 16

item.title: Woodlands Online 30th Annual 12 Days of Christmas Contest 2026 – Woodlands Online (The Woodlands, TX; sponsored by The Strong Firm P.C.)
item.description: Prize: 12 winners: one gift from a local Woodlands-area sponsor drawn each weekday Dec 3–18, 2026 (prizes picked up at the Woodlands Online office). Deadline: December 17, 2026. Fill in the free entry form (name, email, phone, address) on the contest page at woodlandsonline.com. One entry per person. You must live or work in the Woodlands Online service area, be 18+ to win, and pick up the prize with photo ID within 5 business days. Entries Nov 18 – Dec 17, 2026 11:59 p.m.

item.title: Boost Mobile 12 Days of Giveaways 2026 ("12 Days of Boostmas") – Boost Mobile (Boost SubscriberCo L.L.C., EchoStar)
item.description: Prize: Daily drawings Dec 10–21, 2026: $1,000 VISA gift cards, Samsung devices, a Mike Tyson signed gear bundle and a grand prize bundle (Galaxy S26 Ultra, Galaxy Tab A11+ 5G, Galaxy XR, Galaxy Buds4, Galaxy Watch9); total ARV of all prizes about $42,347. Deadline: December 20, 2026. Complete the online entry form at boost12daysofgiveaways.com (name, email, phone, city/state/ZIP; you are opted in to Boost emails, can unsubscribe). One entry per person for the whole period via the website (one per day via in-store QR code); non-winning entries carry forward to later drawings. No purchase necessary. Legal residents of the 48 contiguous US + DC, 18+. Nov 1 – Dec 20, 2026, 11:59:59 PM MT

item.title: Hobby Farms 12 Days of Giveaways – Hobby Farms (EG Media Investments LLC)
item.description: Prize: One prize each day for 12 days (prizes vary by day and are announced on the giveaway page). Deadline: December 12, 2026. Fill in the entry form (name and email) on the Hobby Farms giveaway page, once per day from Dec 1, 2026 12:00 AM ET to Dec 12, 2026 11:30 PM ET. No purchase necessary. Open to legal residents of the 50 US states and DC, 18+. One winner drawn per day from all entries received so far; winners notified by Dec 19, 2026.

item.title: Fast Park 12 Days of Giveaways 2026 – Park Place Operations, Inc. (Fast Park & Relax)
item.description: Prize: 12 daily prizes (total ARV $2,000): Away Weekender Bag, cashmere travel pashmina, $100 Target/LEGO/Disney/Dick's Sporting Goods/Amazon gift cards, Apple AirPods 4, travel packs with a week of free Fast Park parking, Comfrt travel bundle and more. Deadline: December 18, 2026. On each of the 12 giveaway days (Dec 3, 4, 7–11 and 14–18, 2026) enter between 10:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. ET – either follow the instructions in that day's Fast Park post on Facebook, Instagram or TikTok, or (free alternative) email rewards@fastpark.com with the subject "Fast Park 12 Days of Giveaways Sweepstakes" and your full name, mailing address and phone number. One drawing per day. Legal residents of the 50 US states, 18+. No purchase necessary
